title: primula matthioli subsp. brotheri
intro: Primula matthioli subsp. brotheri, commonly known as the Alpine primrose, is a plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family, known for its delicate flowers and medicinal properties. The Alpine primrose has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, digestive issues, and fever, due to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which helps in relieving cough, reducing swelling, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of Primula matthioli subsp. brotheri include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
